lines.zh: 我踩在地上，脚印比同类深一点。
lines.en: My prints sink a little deeper than my kin's.

lines.zh: 我走路时低着头，不看远处。
lines.en: I walk head down, not looking far.
My hide is dark.

lines.zh: 我从山地的碎石上走过。
lines.en: I cross the scree of the mountains.

lines.zh: 碎石在脚下响，我走得慢。
lines.en: Gravel clicks underfoot; I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 红土沾在爪缝里，我不理。
lines.en: Red clay cakes my claws; I ignore it.
I circle the anchor, never far.
Head down, my snout brushes the dirt.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候不爱说话。
lines.en: I do not talk much when I walk.
I keep to the shadowed side.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩实，才不算白走。
lines.en: Each step planted solid, or it doesn't count.
I walk toward the lights.
I stand, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，把你的样子看进去。
lines.en: I raise my eyes and take your shape in.
I am only at the growth stage.
I do not cry out unless I must.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上轻轻敲。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground lightly.
I remember being ordered about.
I do not trust people easily.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能说清的理由。
lines.en: I wait for a reason worth hearing.
I look at things for a long time.
My hands hang at my sides.
There is someone else's scent on the wind.
One blink, then nothing.
Doing nothing suits me.
I have memorized the paths here.
What do you want me to do?
I do not like being commanded.
You can speak plainly.
I am shorter, but I can fight.
Put your hand down; I don't like being touched.
I have been watching you a while.
Are you taking me, or leaving?
I remember that expression.
I will decide for myself.
If you are right, I listen.
You need not name me.

lines.zh: 我靠着石壁，看你要做什么。
lines.en: I lean on the rock wall and watch you.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就当你要动手。
lines.en: One step closer and I'll take it as a strike.

lines.zh: 你给我一样东西，我记着。
lines.en: Give me something and I will remember it.
I owe no one anything.

lines.zh: 你想试，我不介意陪你试。
lines.en: If you want to try, I don't mind trying back.
Jaw clenched, not a sound escapes.
Half a step back, then my feet set.
That hurt; I count it against you.
A small split in my hide.

lines.zh: 泥土味混着血腥，我吸了口气。
lines.en: Dirt and blood in the air; I draw one breath.
I am still standing.
I do not like this pain.
I will return this.
My hand is still shaking.
Go on, try that again.
Meat. Hand it over.

lines.zh: 石头那边，你放好就退开。
lines.en: Over on that stone; set it down and step back.
I do not take from a hand.
This is far too little.

lines.zh: 香味一飘，我喉咙动了一下。
lines.en: The smell drifts over and my throat moves.
Back off, and only then will I eat.
I will eat, but I will not thank you.
If there is more, put down another.
I will leave once I eat.
Do not watch me eat.
I have always eaten fast.
This one is not fresh.
You bumped me. I did not yield.

lines.zh: 撞上来你才知道我有多沉。
lines.en: Hit me and you'll learn how heavy I am.
Get out to one side.
That made you step back.
Do not test me with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你脚跟碾过来，我抽回爪子。
lines.en: Your heel grinds down; I pull my claw back.

lines.zh: 我从你肘边擦过，没停下。
lines.en: I slip past your elbow without stopping.
I drop my weight and do not budge.
Again, and I answer.
You are taller, not steadier.
No time for soft things like that.
I only want to be stronger.
My kin are in the mountains, not here.
This is the wrong one to ask.
I do not like this topic.
There's a debt waiting for me in the mountains.
Ask me after I evolve.
Alone, I make better time.
You should be on your way.
I am leaving this place.

lines.zh: 这块黑的，敲着声音很实。
lines.en: This black one rings solid when struck.

lines.zh: 铁锈味钻进鼻子，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Rust stings my nose; I don't like it.
Heavy enough to break something.
Point the sharp end forward and it's a blade.

lines.zh: 牙磕上去，只留一道白痕。
lines.en: My teeth leave only a white mark.
I tuck it under a scale.
This cannot be eaten at all.

lines.zh: 用不上，我甩手丢进沟里。
lines.en: Useless; I fling it into the ditch.
This is what you dropped.
I am not giving it back.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我就进了一步。
lines.en: You give half a step; I take one.
I raise my head until I can see you.

lines.zh: 它再走三步，我就够得着。
lines.en: Three more steps and it's within reach.
Shoulders down, tail flat to the ground.
First I will see you clearly.
You are taller, but slower.
My throat feels a little warm.
I need make no sound.
The wall is behind you; no retreat.

lines.zh: 它还没转身，我脚已经动了。
lines.en: It hasn't turned, and my feet are already moving.
This blow must land squarely.
Do not think I hesitate.

lines.zh: 你先迈哪只脚，我都记着。
lines.en: Whichever foot you lead with, I'm counting.
You move, and my feet turn.
I will not go the long way.
You are forcing your breathing.
Heel first, and the sound is small.
There are stones behind you.
I need no speed. I am steady enough.

lines.zh: 你的手一抬，我就压低身子。
lines.en: When your hand lifts, I drop lower.
Your fingers tremble; I see it.
I wait for you to miss.
Your foot slipped.
Your footsteps have gone ragged.
I strike with a claw.
My fist is not heavy, but accurate.
That lands on your ribs.
I bite your forearm.
You throw me off; I come again.
I ram your knee.

lines.zh: 咬完就放，我退回自己的位置。
lines.en: Bite, release, and I step back to my ground.
Blow after blow, without a sound.

lines.zh: 打在你肋骨上，你该明白。
lines.en: That hit your ribs; you should understand now.
You were forced back.
I follow two steps.
That one was only seven-tenths.

lines.zh: 石头后面，我慢慢直起腰。
lines.en: Behind the stones, I slowly straighten up.
My first breath tastes of earth.

lines.zh: 我的身体比同类深一号。
lines.en: My body is a shade darker than my kin's.
Mountains here, and badlands.

lines.zh: 第一脚踩进碎石，有点疼。
lines.en: My first step into gravel stings a little.

lines.zh: 四条腿撑住，风推不动我。
lines.en: Four legs braced; the wind can't move me.
I raise my head and see distant light.
I do not want to speak.
I remember how I came here.

lines.zh: 我记得没人问过我要不要。
lines.en: I remember no one asked if I wanted it.
I dig my claws into the gravel.
I stood there a long time.
Fire sweeps in; I take a step back.
I land on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我爪子在泥里刨。
lines.en: Water pours down my throat; my claws dig at the mud.

lines.zh: 气浪推我撞上岩壁，我滑下来。
lines.en: The blast slams me into the cliff and I slide down.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在小腿上，我没拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my calf; I leave it.
A curse rises and I go cold all over.
Too long hungry; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 白光劈下，我四肢一齐麻。
lines.en: White light strikes; all four limbs go numb.

lines.zh: 黑得看不见底，我抓不住。
lines.en: Black all the way down; nothing to grab.
